SMTO-SKL-0038 — More than one Drive file could match, so SMTO stopped

GUID: d2ea5291-0ce3-5314-8b78-23860332b458
Slug: google-drive-file-ambiguous
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • This message, from an older SMTO record, says more than one Drive file matched your request. A file name alone isn't a safe way to choose what to change, so SMTO needs the exact file.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to search Google Drive and show you every file that matches, with its folder and last-changed date. Seeing all the matches makes it clear which file you actually mean.
  2. Tell SMTO which file in the list to use, then ask for the change again. SMTO only changes a file once it is pointed at one exact file.
  3. Open Google Drive and check the other matching files to confirm none were changed by mistake. This record comes from an older version, so it can't prove nothing happened at the time.

What success looks like

  • Only the file you chose shows the change in Google Drive.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't rename or delete files just to make the name unique.
